wiki.title: Katie Wallace
wiki.extract: Katie Wallace is an American politician and political organizer from Longmont, Colorado. A Democrat, Wallace currently represents Colorado's 17th Senate district. Wallace was selected by vacancy committee to represent the district following the resignation of Sonya Jaquez Lewis.
